---
name: SOS request
about: Carry a worksheet from 767-2687.com into the open and ask for help
title: "SOS: "
labels: []
---

NEED — what has to happen?


YES — what must remain true?


BOUNDARY — what would make you decline or stop?


TIME — when does the boundary or permission expire?


Responsibility — who owns the decision, and what remains afterward?


Evidence — what was checked, and what is still unknown?


Handle (optional) — a label for yourself. A handle does not establish identity or authority.
